title: Tech tree
subtitle: Everything your side can build, from the commander up
text: The tree is read from the game you are running: your side's commander, and every builder and factory its build menus lead to, each one's menu exactly as the sidebar shows it. A mod's own units, levels and upgrades are all there.

Each card is a builder or a factory. Under its name are the units it is the first to unlock; the line on the left leads back to whatever builds it. Click a card or a unit to light the way to it from the commander, what it builds and what else can build it, and to open its panel.
The panel shows the unit turning in 3D. Drag to look around it, use the wheel to come closer, and press Walk, Aim, Fire or Build: the unit plays its own animation for it, as it does in the game.

Some mods let a building be upgraded in place. An upgrade has a dashed purple frame: it is built onto its building and never stands on its own. A unit with upgrades has a purple frame and lists them in its panel.
Drag the tree to move it and use the wheel to zoom. Fit shows the whole tree again.
